proposition: Four works in this range are given composition dates that differ from any Majlis 10196 colophon: the Munāẓarāt-i Khams (Muḥarram 808/June-July 1405), the R. Ḥurūf (10 Ramaḍān 817/23 November 1414, Shiraz), the Asrār al-Ṣalāt (21 Jumādā II 820/5 August 1417, Herat) and the K. al-Mafāḥiṣ (823/1420); Melvin-Koushki does not name the source of the first three dates in the entries.

mediation.note: sources of the dates not stated in the entries
